# Contextro Agent Map

Use Contextro MCP as the default code discovery layer when it is available.

## Workflow

1. Run `status()` and `index()` the repository only when it is not already indexed.
2. Use `search()` before broad file reads.
3. Use `find_symbol()`, `explain()`, `find_callers()`, and `find_callees()` for symbol and dependency discovery.
4. Use `impact()` before renaming, deleting, or changing shared signatures.
5. Use `overview()` or `architecture()` to orient in unfamiliar codebases.
6. Read full files only after the relevant scope has been narrowed.
